content:
mira: Quick check — I kicked off a tiny sampling job to catch accounts stuck in onboarding (status = 'started') with zero activity for >14 days and owner last_activity >30d. Want a quick ops review before we wire it into a playbook.

ajay: Can you paste the query? want to eyeball edge cases. :eyes:

mira: Sure — draft below:
```sql
SELECT account_id, owner_id, onboarding_status, last_user_activity_at, owner_last_touch_at, tier, company_email_domain
FROM accounts
WHERE onboarding_status = 'started'
  AND last_user_activity_at < now() - interval '14 days'
  AND owner_last_touch_at < now() - interval '30 days'
  AND is_active = true
ORDER BY last_user_activity_at ASC
LIMIT 500;
```

ajay: Nice. Two quick asks: 1) add cohort filter (trial_start between X and Y) so we don't pull very old legacy accounts; 2) exclude internal test orgs by domain (internal.company.com, staging.*).

liz: Also we should only trigger the owner-nudge playbook for CS tier != 'enterprise' and exclude accounts with pending_renewal = true. We don't want automated nudges for high-touch renewals.

cs-bot: sample-job created: sample_onboard_gap_4759876543 by mira. Scheduled: adhoc, output -> cs-ops sampling S3 prefix.

mira: Thanks — can we run a dry-run and dump preview to #cs-ops-sampling? I want to sanity-check false positives first.

ops-bot: dry-run complete — 42 rows found. Preview link: https://s3.console.aws/preview/sample_onboard_gap_4759876543.csv (redacted)

ajay: Scanned the preview: ~6 rows look like internal/test accounts, 2 are enterprise with pending_renewal flagged incorrectly. Suggest adding `AND company_email_domain NOT ILIKE '%internal.company.com%'` and `AND pending_renewal = false` to the query.

liz: Add `last_successful_login` guard too — if last_successful_login < 60 days then ok to nudge, else skip (some automation-only accounts).

mira: Good catches — I'll update and re-run tonight. Proposed rollout: (1) weekly sampling, (2) canary owner-nudge playbook to 10% of sampled owners, (3) manual QC step for ops for first 3 weeks, (4) full automation if false positive rate < 5%.

ajay: Add acceptance criteria: FP rate <5% and ops sign-off on canary batch. Also add metric: owner-response-rate within 7 days.

liz: :white_check_mark: lgtm. Can you drop the updated query and the playbook sequence in the runbook doc? I'll schedule the ops review on Monday.

mira: Will do — dropping updated query + canary plan into runbook: https://docs.internal/runbooks/onboard-gap-sampler (ETA: Mon EOD). Thanks all!
